method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: get_certificate
tools.title: Get DigiCert Private CA Certificate
tools.description: Retrieve a DigiCert Private CA certificate by ID using the DigiCert API key from the current MCP request x-api-key header.

tools.name: list_certificates
tools.title: List DigiCert Private CA Certificates
tools.description: List DigiCert Private CA certificates associated with an issuer using exactly one of serial_number, subject_key_id, or subject_public_key. Only offset, limit, and sort are supported in addition to that selector; do not pass status or any other unsupported query fields. Authentication uses the DigiCert API key from the current MCP request x-api-key header.

serial_number.description: Issuer certificate serial number. Provide exactly one selector field.
serial_number.title: Serial Number

subject_key_id.description: Issuer certificate subject key identifier. Provide exactly one selector field.
subject_key_id.title: Subject Key Id

subject_public_key.description: Issuer certificate subject public key. Provide exactly one selector field.
subject_public_key.title: Subject Public Key

tools.name: list_certificate_authorities
tools.title: List DigiCert Private CAs
tools.description: List DigiCert Private certificate authorities the caller has access to. Returns the raw DigiCert API response using the DigiCert API key from the current MCP request x-api-key header.

tools.name: get_certificate_authority
tools.title: Get DigiCert Private CA
tools.description: Retrieve a DigiCert Private certificate authority by CA ID and return the raw DigiCert API response using the DigiCert API key from the current MCP request x-api-key header.

tools.name: get_certificate_authority_status

tools.name: get_certificate_authority_hierarchy

tools.description: Retrieve the root hierarchy for a DigiCert Private certificate authority by CA ID and return the raw DigiCert API response using the DigiCert API key from the current MCP request x-api-key header.

tools.name: list_certificate_templates

tools.name: get_certificate_template

tools.name: list_discovered_certificates
tools.title: List DigiCert Discovered Certificates
tools.description: Use this tool for broad certificate discovery requests, including listing all certificates, listing certificates filtered only by certificate type, and applying MCP-side constraints on certificate fields such as validity.valid_from, validity.valid_to, cert_type, trust_type, hosted_type, csr_type, revocation.revoked, revocation.reason, revocation.revoke_date, subject.common_name, or issuer.id. When limit is omitted, the MCP server fetches all discovery pages before returning results. Authentication uses the DigiCert API key from the current MCP request x-api-key header.

field.description: Certificate field to filter on using dot notation, for example csr_type, trust_type, hosted_type, validity.valid_to, revocation.revoked, revocation.reason, issuer.id, or subject.common_name
field.title: Field

operator.description: Comparison operator. Use within_next_days with a date field such as validity.valid_to to find certificates expiring within a time window.
operator.title: Operator

value.description: Comparison value. Required for all operators except exists. For in, provide a JSON array. For within_next_days, provide the number of days.

cert_type.description: Optional certificate type filter such as end_entity
cert_type.title: Cert Type

constraints.description: Optional MCP-side constraints applied after certificate discovery is fetched. Use this for fields that the downstream API does not filter directly, such as csr_type, cert_type, trust_type, hosted_type, validity.valid_from, validity.valid_to, revocation.revoked, revocation.reason, or revocation.revoke_date.
constraints.title: Constraints

tools.name: download_certificates_csv
tools.title: Download DigiCert Certificates CSV
tools.description: Download the DigiCert Private CA certificate list as CSV text with optional pagination and certificate type filtering. Authentication uses the DigiCert API key from the current MCP request x-api-key header.

cert_type.description: Optional certificate type filter such as ee, ca, or ica
cert_type.title: Cert Type

tools.name: list_audit_logs
